messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: C# sampleapp failing on rerank after latest SDK sync. Looks like batching helper pads to 2048 for some reason.
June: Is model.redwood-embed-1 1024?
Ravi: Yes. Encoder outputs 1024, helper pads some entries to 2048 when batch has a partial last group.
Marta: Also noticed ordering flip: some responses now return id before embedding on gateway nodes. Our sample maps by index, so that silently misaligns.
Ravi: Minimal repro: run samples/csharp/repro.cs --model redwood-embed-1 --batch 6  # prints vector len per item.
CLI-bot: Job queued: unit-tests/csharp_embed at 04:00 UTC.
June: Quick fix: change pad policy to pad_to_model_dim in C# helper and add a warn log when trim/pad happens. Also add idempotency header support so token-refresh retries don't double-submit.
Marta: Filed issue platform#2620 for EMBEDDING_DIM_MISMATCH 400 + metric and gateway enforcement of response field ordering.
devex: Assigning to June and Ravi. Please include integration tests for 512/1024/2048 across SDKs.
Ravi: I'll open PR for the C# SDK today, add the warn log, and update onboarding notes about mapping by id not index. Will run canary after staging deploy and report back.
devex: Thanks — paste canary results here when available.
Ravi: Will do. :thumbsup:
